text:
Priya: Morning async — drop your 3s (yesterday / today / blockers). Quick highlights: 1) Canary rollout for model-router v0.9.3 at 10:30 PT; 2) cost dashboard anomaly (paging @Liam); 3) CR ping: please review PR #3421 (routing fallback) by EOD. Link to logs: https://internal.redwood/logs/1977777733 :rocket:

Liam: Looking into the cost spike — saw a batching throughput jump around 02:12 UTC. Reproduced in staging with smaller batch sizes. Plan: hotfix to batcher config and redeploy by ~09:45 PT. @eng-sre if you see errors, add :alert: here.

Rosa: Yesterday: finished the sampling harness for evals. Today: start wiring it into Optimize suggestions. Blocker: need the labeled test set from @Sam to validate thresholds.

Ken: CR ping — left line comments on #3421. Main question: how does the fallback policy choose between quantized variants vs regional fallback? Also can we emit a metric for `kv_cache_hit`?

Alex: Running canary checks now. Health looks OK from my side. Quick smoke check I ran:
```
curl -sS https://canary.redwood.io/health | jq .
# expect: {"status":"ok","latency_ms": 12}
```
Posted dashboard snapshot: https://dash.redwood/shot/1977777733

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started — service: model-router, version: v0.9.3, target: 10% traffic. Watch /deploys/1977777733 and react if errors > 0.5% in next 15m.

Maya: QA update — ran smoke tests against canary, observed intermittent assertion in embedding pipeline (fails ~1/30 runs). Filed ticket #478. Short stack: see below.

Ken: Can you paste the stacktrace, Maya? I hit a similar flake last week in staging.

Maya: Stack (trimmed):
```
AssertionError: expected batch_length == cache_len
  at EmbeddingPipeline._apply_cache (embedding/pipeline.py:142)
  at EmbeddingPipeline.process (embedding/pipeline.py:98)
```
Adding more logs to the ticket.

Sam: Sent dataset link to Priya and Rosa: https://internal.redwood/datasets/evals/2026-03 — includes the new sampled prompts and ground truth.

qa-bot: Smoke tests: 49 passed, 1 flaky (embedding pipeline) — ticket #478 created.

Priya: Thanks all. If you're on-call or close to the canary, please monitor the canary dashboard and post any alerts here. I'll collect blockers and surface them at the sync. If PR reviewers can take #3421 now that Ken and Alex left comments, that would help unblock roll forward. :white_check_mark:
